ruling: - **R3.** Owner 14:09 CST Nov 10: "time limits as a rule make little to no sense when they feel arbitrary and are not outcomes related ... I understand keeping time limits at some point for letting hung tests end". Form accepted 14:10 CST ("yes, that three-part form matches what I meant"): 1. Stop on silence, not total time: a run ends only after it prints nothing for a while. 2. A stop reads "hung", never "failed": never red, never a merge refusal; retried once, then reported. 3. A total-time limit that must stay (CI billing) comes from measured green runs each time, never a number stored in code. Details, owner 14:24 CST Nov 10 (answers to triage's four points): - A check that gives a verdict (lint, tests, Retire) stops on silence, reads "hung", retries once. Any other background command is only reported and keeps running (decision stall-watch). ("yes that's ok") - Every CI job keeps a total-time limit, computed from recent green runs by a script, generously large. Local tools use the silence stop only. ("it should be generously large maybe") - merge.deadlineMinutes is computed each time from the current CI limits; reaching it reads "CI still running", never a refusal. ("this needs to be a moving target") - The silence window is measured per tool from the longest gap between output lines in green runs. - Margins multiply, never add: "+5m is not as generous as like +1.5x". - A new CI job with no green runs: its nearest similar job's computed limit x1.5. If it hits that limit, it is flagged as misjudged and moves to the largest current job's computed limit x1.5. Owner 14:36 CST: "b is probably fine for now, with some sorta flag that if it quickly fails that it was misjudged and it goes to largest current job x1.5"; 14:37 CST: "if it was just made and it then fails in its first run or two that's a sign it was misjudged". Replaces the stored 60 min in ci-job-caps. - A job stops being new after its first green run. The nearest similar job does the same kind of work (lint, test, mutation, build); with none, the largest current job x1.5. Owner 15:03 CST: "yes thats fine agreed". Replaces: merge/merge.py LINT_SECONDS 1200, lint/check_debt_retire.py TIMEOUT 600, hooks/mutate_guard.py and janitor/mutate_sweep.py 1200, lint/check_python_floor.py 300. Home: new decision time-limits-end-hangs-only; decision ci-job-caps rewritten to match.
